title: Contract Size and the Ridgeline Installation Services Customer Reschedule Fee
content:
The size of a Ridgeline Installation Services job sets the job-size share of the customer reschedule fee: large jobs tie up a crew block that is costly to move, small jobs much less so.

## Job-size share

The contract price billed on the contract is read from its contract billing line, the line on which the contract price was billed at signing.

| Contract price billed | Job-size share |
|---|---|
| at or above the large-job floor of 15000.00 | 1.5, the large-job multiple |
| below the small-job ceiling of 2500.00 | 0.9, the small-job share |
| any other contract price (from 2500.00 up to, but not including, 15000.00) | 1 |

The customer reschedule fee is multiplied by the job-size share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the customer reschedule fee is rounded, the customer reschedule fee being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Boundary figures

| Contract price billed | Share |
|---|---|
| 15000.00 | 1.5 |
| 14999.99 | 1 |
| 2500.00 | 1 |
| 2499.99 | 0.9 |

## Points of judgement

- The price used is the contract price on the contract billing line. Change orders are billed on their own lines and do not form part of it.

## Worked figures (hypothetical fee of 150.00 before the share)

| Contract price billed | Share | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 18400.00 | 1.5 | 225.00 |
| 2100.00 | 0.9 | 135.00 |
| 7999.00 | 1 | 150.00 |
